title: Valuables Floater Premium Payments and Credit Balance Refunds
content:
Billing desk note, Larkspur Valuables Floater premium account.

**Rule.** Payments apply oldest charge first and are recorded with their confirmation or check number exactly as issued; a credit of at least the tier's smallest refundable credit balance is refunded by the method of the last payment.

## The premium account

The floater's premium balance is the premium owed on the floater: a positive balance is owed to Larkspur, a negative balance is a credit to the named insured. Installments billed, additional premium and refunds raise it; payments received and return premium lower it.

## Points of the rule

- **Order of application.** A payment is applied to the oldest open charge on the account first, and only then to later charges.
- **Reference.** The payment is recorded with its confirmation number or check number exactly as issued, character for character.
- **Refund of a credit.** A credit balance of at least the tier's smallest refundable credit balance is refunded, by the same method as the last payment received (EFT, card or check).

## Hypothetical illustrations

- **Oldest first.** A Larkspur Valuables Floater account shows an installment of 62.56 USD billed in February and an additional premium of 15.52 USD charged in September, both unpaid. A payment of 70.00 USD settles the February installment first, and the remaining 7.44 USD goes to the September charge.
- **Refund.** After a return premium the balance stands at a credit of 12.40 USD, and the last payment was made by check. 12.40 USD is at least the 5.00 USD figure, so it is refunded by check.
- **Credit below the figure.** A credit of 3.10 USD is below 5.00 USD, the smallest credit balance refunded, and is not refunded.
